title: Missing Meroke Village Marker, Merrick
summary: A former New York State historic marker in Merrick acknowledged a Meroke village area. It is no longer standing, but its text keeps local memory of Meroke presence visible.
address_label: Sunrise Highway vicinity, west of Central Boulevard, Merrick
ancestral_territory_note: Linked to Merrick Ancestral Land through the former public marker and Meroke place history.
why_this_matters: The missing Meroke marker shows how Native place history can be acknowledged in one generation and fade from the roadside landscape in another. Restoring the story helps reconnect Merrick to Meroke presence while treating village places with respect.
introduction_content: New York State placed a historical marker in Merrick in the 1930s acknowledging a Meroke village area near Sunrise Highway. Although the roadside marker has been missing for many years, its wording documents how Meroke presence was acknowledged in the public landscape. It does not establish the precise location of a village or archaeological place.
preservation_content: The missing marker shows how Native place history can be acknowledged in one generation and fade from the roadside landscape in another. Restoring the story through careful interpretation and local sources helps reconnect Merrick to Meroke presence while treating village places with respect.
